left.title: Trump Foundation shuts down amid lawsuit alleging a “shocking pattern of illegality”
left.body: The New York attorney general is still pursuing a lawsuit against the president’s charitable organization.
left.roundup: The Trump Foundation will close amid a lawsuit from New York Attorney General Barbara Underwood that alleges the charity engaged in a "shocking pattern of illegality" to further President Trump's personal and political interests.
